scope: CAD X1-A three-point circle and start-through-end arc
checks: translated normalized circumcenter and radius independently checked at local and 1e9 mm coordinates
CW/CCW, semicircle and major arc preserve the ordered through point
duplicate, collinear, ill-conditioned and non-finite points reject; UI retains invalid third-point draft
existing circle/arc source, unique editable identities, explicit radius constraints and live extrusion regeneration
XY/XZ/YZ and resolved face-sketch frames, locks and off-plane rejection
numeric units/relative points, pointer confirmation, Cancel, Preview/Apply and one-entry Undo/Redo
existing document serialization and exact DXF major clockwise arc round-trip
limitations: Three acquired points define creation-time circle/arc values, not permanent live point references
Automatic sketch constraint inference is omitted to avoid mapping circumference picks to the centre
Arbitrary standalone UCS creation is X5; tangent construction and regular polygon creation remain X1-B/C
